title: Antigravity catalog visibility UI handoff proof
trusted_prompt: Polish the already mounted catalog visibility feature without changing its architecture. Your only create/edit grant is the literal admin/src/features/catalog-visibility/** root. The Codex coordinator owns admin/src/api.ts, admin/src/catalog-state.ts, App.tsx, routing, shared/global styles, manifests, lockfiles, build configuration, CI, runner, rules, hooks, and every other path. All required task content is already in this prompt: read only within the current worktree, never the coordinator checkout, sibling worktrees, or any external task snapshot. Use the injected CatalogVisibilityProps and its explicit loading, error, empty, and success state union; never call fetch, change the API contract, or replace injected catalog items with hard-coded data. Keep MOCK, localhost-only, read-only, and no-purchase/no-payment messaging unmistakable. You may redesign the feature markup and component-local CSS for strong visual hierarchy, responsive mobile/desktop behavior, keyboard-visible focus, semantic headings, sufficient contrast, and prefers-reduced-motion. Add or update feature-local tests under the same grant for all four states and retry behavior. Do not add dependencies, change config, disable checks, or create/delegate to/resume any subagent, background agent, browser subagent, or second writer. If a required change is outside the grant, return BLOCKED with the reason. Run only the existing frontend lint, typecheck, test, and build commands if authorized; report unavailable checks as NOT_RUN. Return exact changed paths and real evidence in the required structured result.
acceptance_criteria: Loading, error with retry, empty, and success render from the injected coordinator-owned state contract.
The feature never fetches directly or replaces backend catalog data with hard-coded demo items.
MOCK, localhost-only, read-only, and no-purchase/no-payment safety messaging remains visible.
The layout works at narrow mobile and desktop widths with semantic structure, keyboard focus, contrast, and reduced-motion handling.
Feature-local tests cover the four states and retry interaction.
No dependency, manifest, lockfile, configuration, CI, runner, rule, hook, supplier, payment, merge, or deployment change occurs.
No subagent or second writer is created; a valid reviewer finding resumes this same conversation.
